notes: Polymorph encodes cleanly as activation/save_gate using the transform_target atom (§C4d). The Wis save gate on fail applies transform_target: Beast, CR ≤ target CR/level, retaining alignment/personality/creature_type/HP/HD, gaining Temp HP from new form, action restriction no_speech_no_spells, revert triggers temp_hp_depleted and spell_ends. The activation family with concentration duration correctly models the spell ending when temp HP depletes via PolymorphRevertTrigger.temp_hp_depleted. Gear meld is narrative/DM agenda, correctly omitted.
